Overall, this is a very commercial and safe and heteronormative adaptation of The Great Gatsby... but it delivers on exactly that. It delivers on being an entertaining two and a half hour musical with fantastic vocals and beautiful visuals.

Is it the most meaningful? Is it the most emotionally impactful? Is it the most thought-provoking musical that you're going to see on stage? No to any of those things. It is, however, legitimately entertaining.
